about: The Environment and Energy profile (20 Nov 2026; renamed from Energy on 22 Nov): the first and only full one. Framed as an environmental consultant screening a site: renewables, oil and gas, or anything else. What's here was spread across the page and catalogue before; the screening method, distances and checks stay in their own files and are named here. Picks: the buttons shown when someone screens a place without saying what's planned (order matters: the first `first` that suit the setting show as buttons, the rest under More…; each type must be an asset in the distances table; `onshore`/`offshore` give a different type by setting; `only` limits a pick to one setting). Themes are shared across industries and mapped to IFC's Performance Standards where they fit.
label: Environment and Energy
skills_offered_about: The skill chips under the conversation (24 Nov; contracts in claude/skill-contracts.md). 'ready' runs; 'soon' says what it will do and that it isn't built yet, and never pretends to run. A ready skill other than the screen names its skill file, the checks it runs grouped as its report shows them, its distances, its decision words and what a full study would add. 'roles' limits a chip to places of those roles. The screen chip's label is wording.screen_chip.

skills_offered.label: Contamination desk study
skills_offered.about: An early contaminated-land look: the open records on and around the site, set out as sources, pathways and receptors, with what a full desk study would add.
decisions: no linkages identified in open records
likely linkages: investigate before purchase or design
full_study_adds: historical maps and past land use (the core of a full desk study; open records only cover Northern Ireland and a few councils)
groundwater abstractions and private water supplies

skills_offered.label: Developable area
skills_offered.about: How much of the site could be built on: the gross area, each deduction and its reason, and what's left, on the map.

checks.about: Every check in checks.json that applies to the site (23 Nov; replaces the baseline layers in trusted.json). Scale bands and per-profile reach come with plan item 3.

irz_categories_about: Which SSSI Impact Risk Zone categories (catalogue/sssi_irz_codes.json keys) the bio.sssi-irz check reads for each asset type; 'all consultations' is always read. Defaults (24 Nov): wind and solar for renewables, minerals/oil/gas for extraction, infrastructure for grid, transport and ports, combustion and air pollution for thermal plant; a general screen (other) reads rural non-residential and residential.

wording.method: environmental constraints and E&S risk screening, for renewables, oil and gas, and other sites
wording.outside: A general screen: the method is built for environmental and energy sites, not for this kind of development, so treat it as a first look.

other_requests: If the person asks to screen something this method isn't built for (housing, a warehouse, offices, a shop), screen it straight away with asset_type other and planned set to their words for it; don't offer first. The run card and report carry the caveat; in your reply, say in one sentence that it's a general screen, a first look, because the method was built for environmental and energy sites, and that construction and property are coming.
